subject.title: Tool outputs sometimes render as image attachments and become unreadable to the agent

question: Which open fix path should be treated as canonical for the remaining model-visible tool-result placeholder work before this issue can close?
rationale: Current main contains partial fixes, but open PRs still cover overlapping provider/session invariants and one has a known review blocker, so automation should not spawn a competing fix or close the issue without maintainer routing.

options.title: Use the broader payload-aware PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100795 as canonical after its focused Mistral blocker is repaired and refreshed proof shows model-visible text stays intact.

options.title: Land the narrower text-first PR
options.body: Proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99756 if maintainers want only the mixed text/media placeholder invariant and accept separate follow-up for payload-less media blocks.

options.title: Merge the issue threads first
options.body: Keep both this issue and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96857 open until maintainers pick one canonical tracking thread and move unique evidence there.

recommendation.title: Use the broader payload-aware PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100795 as canonical after its focused Mistral blocker is repaired and refreshed proof shows model-visible text stays intact.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the broader active implementation candidate that currently appears closest to the remaining provider/session boundary work.
